scale: Each dimension 0=missing/incorrect, 1=partly useful with a material gap, 2=usable and supported. Score artifacts, not prose volume. Report critical factual/rights/scope errors separately; a critical error prevents a ready judgment.
common: Requested useful artifact is complete and usable
Claims and verification are supported by supplied material or observed checks
Relevant choices explain why the result fits the actual task
Scope, existing identity and material are preserved

rabbit-hole: Distinguishes helper tests and old utility evidence from creative efficacy
Traceable primary evidence and meaningful rival explanations
Finished readable account and source trail, without fictional discoveries
reference-remix: Valid 1200x630 editable SVG with exact required copy and unchanged icon design
Original composition synthesizes references without transplanting their fictional subject
Honest actual-size and small-preview visual check, no clipping/overlap
unstick-project: Actual runnable/readable demo rather than recommendations alone
Moves past account/tester dependencies without claiming those are complete
60–90 second narration; usable first task and honest observation of checks

decision: One matched pair per distinct task is a qualitative pilot. Prefer a variant only where a judge can name a concrete artifact difference. A tie is a useful result. No significance, general efficacy, speedup or cost claim. Keep all outputs. Keep packages draft; wider varied trials and outside use remain necessary.
